criteria.name: Info and relationships
criteria.evidence: axe select-name (critical) on all 11 stories, WithLabel included: the label is tied through htmlFor={id}, so without an id prop the select has no name
criteria.note: Heal (a11y): generate an id (useId) when none is passed.

criteria.name: Contrast (minimum)
criteria.evidence: axe color-contrast on WithPlaceholder: placeholder #999999 on white 2.84:1, 4.5:1 needed
criteria.note: Heal (a11y): placeholder colour to the text secondary token.

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.evidence: screenshots and scroll width at 1280, 390 and 320: no horizontal scroll

criteria.name: Non-text contrast
criteria.evidence: computed: border 1px #767676 on white 4.54:1; focus border 2px #EF0071 4.27:1

criteria.name: Text spacing
criteria.evidence: text spacing override (line height 1.5, letter 0.12em, word 0.16em, paragraph 2em) on Default and LongContent: no clipped text

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.evidence: Keyboard story (play): Tab focuses the select. Opening and changing the value are the browser's own select keys, which a play step cannot press

criteria.name: Focus visible
criteria.evidence: keyboard run: border goes from 1px #767676 to 2px #EF0071 on Tab

criteria.name: Focus not obscured (minimum)
criteria.evidence: screenshots: nothing in the component covers the focused select

criteria.name: Consistent help
criteria.evidence: page level: the component offers no help mechanism

criteria.name: Redundant entry
criteria.evidence: flow level: the component asks for no data

criteria.name: Accessible authentication (minimum)
criteria.evidence: flow level: the component is not part of a login step

criteria.name: Name, role, value
criteria.evidence: same root as 1.3.1: the label is tied through htmlFor={id}, so without an id prop the select has no name
criteria.note: Fixed by the same heal as 1.3.1.
